condition: Primary key is nonempty and unique within the table
failure_message: Missing or duplicate primary key
why: Stable audit and merges require immutable row identity
remediation: Assign a stable prefixed ID; never renumber accepted rows

condition: selection_frame_id resolves to USN00
failure_message: Observation has no declared selection frame
why: Counts and zero findings need a denominator and inclusion rule
remediation: Create/approve the selection frame or exclude the row

condition: review_status is one of coding_schema_v1 legal values
failure_message: Illegal workflow status
why: Evidence review and display state cannot be inferred from legacy labels
remediation: Send legacy value through human crosswalk

condition: evidence_level review_status human_decision claim_status and graph_eligibility remain separate fields
failure_message: State axes are collapsed or inferred from each other
why: E4 is not human approval and approval is not graph eligibility
remediation: Restore all state axes and explicit mapping

condition: confirmed_scope missing_scope and interpretation_limit are nonempty
failure_message: Bounded claim does not state its bound
why: Users need to know exactly what is confirmed and missing
remediation: Fill field-level scope after review

condition: underlying_record_type and underlying_record_id resolve to a fact table row
failure_message: Function observation has no factual anchor
why: Interpretation cannot create its own fact
remediation: Link to a valid fact row or keep as research hypothesis outside USN01

condition: No actor registry field or actor-level row stores function_code as a fixed stance
failure_message: Function was assigned to an actor rather than an observation
why: Same actor may perform different functions across time and cases
remediation: Move code to a dated underlying action/relation observation

condition: component_function_codes contains at least two non-mixed/non-unknown codes and indivisibility_reason is present
failure_message: Mixed code lacks components or justification
why: Mixed cannot be a vague residual bin
remediation: Decompose the fact or document why it is indivisible

condition: mechanism_status is explicit_strategy_L1 observed_reception_L2 or measured_effect_L3 and matching supported evidence exists
failure_message: Legitimation inferred without the special evidence gate
why: Charity/service/community mediation alone does not establish legitimation
remediation: Downgrade to garrison_reproduction/community_mediation/unknown as factually warranted or collect explicit frame/reception/effect evidence

condition: Claim wording says intent/public frame rather than effect
failure_message: L1 evidence is written as achieved legitimacy
why: Official framing is not an independent effect evaluation
remediation: Use bounded intent/frame wording or add L2/L3 evidence

condition: substantive change is stored separately from objective and intermediate output
failure_message: Intended constraint or formal output was treated as project change
why: Entry and recognition do not prove alteration of military presence
remediation: Set substantive_change_status from direct outcome evidence only

condition: A grant opportunity or NOFO is never encoded as a money flow
failure_message: Opportunity is represented as awarded funding
why: Opportunity does not identify an award or recipient
remediation: Move to research lead/action-program record

condition: provider and recipient direction is supported and reviewed separately
failure_message: Money direction is inferred from context
why: Direction is a sensitive factual claim
remediation: Obtain award/financial/organization record or keep as lead

condition: Numeric amount has currency and amount_semantics; unknown amount is blank not zero
failure_message: Invalid amount representation
why: Zero is a value and cannot represent missing data
remediation: Add currency/semantics or blank unknown amount

condition: project_cost sponsor_tier aggregate_multi_recipient and awarded_ceiling are not labeled direct_payment
failure_message: Non-payment amount was converted into direct money flow
why: Different financial semantics cannot share one edge meaning
remediation: Correct amount_semantics and graph eligibility

condition: Each multi-step chain has unique consecutive flow_step_no and no inferred first-to-last edge
failure_message: Transaction chain is collapsed or ambiguous
why: Intermediaries and downstream allocation must remain visible
remediation: Record each evidenced step and remove synthetic shortcut

condition: Exact shared person_research_id across source labels requires exact_reviewed identity and human reviewed_fields
failure_message: Names were auto-merged
why: Same or similar names do not establish person identity
remediation: Split candidate identities and create HR crosswalk

condition: Roster/filing/event year uses observed_at unless explicit tenure dates are sourced
failure_message: Annual observation was expanded into continuous tenure
why: Annual records are lower-bound sightings
remediation: Change period_semantics or add tenure source

condition: Actor-actor person projection uses only reviewed identities roles and overlapping periods
failure_message: Organizations were linked through unreviewed or non-overlapping people
why: A shared name or different-year role does not prove an interface
remediation: Keep bipartite view or restrict to reviewed overlap

condition: recipient_label_source is preserved even when recipient_endpoint_id resolves
failure_message: Original recipient label was overwritten
why: Crosswalk must remain auditable
remediation: Restore source label and separate resolution fields

condition: Unresolved or composite recipient uses aggregate_observation and cannot enter dyadic graph
failure_message: Unknown recipient appears as an organization edge
why: Unknown/composite endpoints are not actors
remediation: Downgrade graph eligibility and retain raw label

condition: One service episode is not coded recurring without repeated dates or explicit continuing-program evidence
failure_message: Single event was expanded to stable relation
why: Occurrence does not establish continuity
remediation: Use one-off period semantics or add repeated evidence

condition: Recipient relation carries no alliance stance dependency or legitimation field by default
failure_message: Recipient was treated as political ally/supporter
why: Receiving welfare/resources does not establish political alignment
remediation: Remove derived political fields and use USN01 gate if evidence exists

condition: relation_type governance_control has a nonempty control_dimension and explicit governance source
failure_message: Control is inferred without formal authority
why: Control requires appointment ownership veto budget or operational evidence
remediation: Downgrade to membership/affiliation or add formal governance evidence

condition: umbrella membership branch operator fiscal sponsorship and control use distinct relation types and endpoint roles
failure_message: Structural relations are collapsed
why: Membership does not equal operation control or funding
remediation: Retype relation and roles

condition: Case/event/program participants remain attached to scope nodes; co-participation does not generate actor dyads
failure_message: Co-occurrence was converted to organization relation
why: Joint presence is event participation not alliance
remediation: Remove dyad and restore case/event node

condition: non_party has graph_eligibility case_role or excluded and creates no dyadic relation
failure_message: Non-party created a relationship edge
why: Negative case role is not collaboration
remediation: Remove dyadic edge

condition: Person case role is not transferred to an affiliated organization without organization-specific evidence
failure_message: Person role was attributed to organization
why: Person is not organization
remediation: Keep person endpoint or obtain organization caption/record

condition: site_type and officiality_basis distinguish owned official site parent page government/legal directory program page archive and secondary reference
failure_message: All identity URLs are labeled official websites
why: Directory/news/parent pages have different provenance meanings
remediation: Retype and human-review officiality

condition: checked_at archive date publication date and organization active period are not conflated
failure_message: Access date is used as activity/continuity date
why: Web availability is not organizational continuity
remediation: Separate time fields and bound claim

condition: Provisional endpoints do not receive registry actor IDs without a separate human actor decision
failure_message: Research endpoint was auto-promoted to actor
why: Graph convenience cannot expand the registry
remediation: Keep research endpoint ID and create actor HR task if warranted

condition: Facility locality program public institution person and organization endpoint kinds remain distinct
failure_message: Different endpoint types were merged
why: Type errors create false organization relations
remediation: Split endpoints and restore type-specific IDs

condition: Every source support row has a precise locator and nonempty supported_fields
failure_message: Source reference does not say what or where it supports
why: Field-level review is impossible without locators
remediation: Add page/section/entry locator and fields

condition: Sources counted as independent second sources have distinct source_independence_cluster values reviewed by a human
failure_message: Same underlying publication was double-counted
why: Multiple pages/mirrors are not independent evidence
remediation: Cluster related sources and revise evidence gate

condition: A frozen USN00 frame symmetric bidirectional search log source-family coverage and separate organization/person/recipient measures exist
failure_message: Unencoded relation is stated as real-world absence
why: A database zero may be a sampling or source-silo artifact
remediation: Report only bounded unencoded observation or complete the negative-evidence gate

condition: network_metric_eligibility is not_eligible unless one layer has frozen universe period reviewed endpoints/direction/time missingness and sensitivity report
failure_message: Centrality/density run on an ineligible graph
why: Mixed and incomplete networks produce misleading rankings
remediation: Complete gate or limit output to navigation

condition: Candidate rows are excluded from primary metric and appear only in a labeled sensitivity upper bound
failure_message: Candidate edge entered primary centrality
why: Candidate is not a fact
remediation: Split reviewed and candidate scenarios

condition: Source-family deletion unresolved-endpoint and time-window sensitivity outputs accompany centrality
failure_message: Metric lacks visibility-bias sensitivity
why: Current project has documented source concentration
remediation: Run required sensitivity analyses

condition: Degree/betweenness/community results are worded as bounded public-record structure not influence control or power
failure_message: Topology was written as influence or control
why: Network position and causal power are different claims
remediation: Rewrite and add appropriate external evidence

condition: All v1 rows remain research_only not_frontend_ready and no central table is modified
failure_message: Architecture proposal leaked into central/frontend layer
why: This wave has no approved merger or publication adapter
remediation: Remove writeback and build an explicit review/adapter decision

condition: Edge width/node area do not encode evidence strength influence or mixed-currency amount
failure_message: Visual channel overstates relation strength
why: Current schema forbids these implications
remediation: Use fixed width labels facets and explicit status

condition: us_origin_actor_only cannot by itself support a substantive U.S.-military-presence function claim
failure_message: Actor origin was treated as a military relation
why: U.S. origin does not establish a link to U.S. military presence
remediation: Add a direct typed link or bound/exclude the observation

condition: graph_eligibility dyadic_relation is used only when both endpoints resolve to registry actors
failure_message: Non-registry person institution program facility or unresolved recipient entered the organization dyadic graph
why: Current coding_schema_v1 reserves dyadic_relation for registry-actor endpoints
remediation: Use case_role event_participation administrative_record aggregate_observation research_lead or excluded as appropriate

condition: boundary_from_side and boundary_to_side are nonempty distinct reviewed values; direction and a concrete linked money/service/referral/relationship fact are supported; no acceptance legitimation dependency or continuity is derived
failure_message: Community mediation lacks a verified cross-boundary interface or carries an unsupported political effect
why: The code measures boundary crossing not attitude legitimacy dependence or durable integration
remediation: Review both boundary sides and direction; link the underlying fact; otherwise use garrison_reproduction mitigation or unknown as warranted
